sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Blank-Check Entity for Public Market Acquisition Mergers (SPAC)

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) - freedom of establishment, free movement of capital and EU financial services passport
Luxembourg-United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (signed 3 April 1996, as amended by the 2009 and 2014 Protocols)
Luxembourg-China Double Taxation Agreement (signed 12 March 2018; in force since 31 July 2019)
Luxembourg-Netherlands Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (8 May 1968, as amended)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended (including the Law of 13 January 2019 transposing EU AML Directives 4 and 5 and the 2023 amendments aligning the UBO register with the CJEU judgment of 22 November 2022, C-37/20 and C-601/20); Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Luxembourg beneficial ownership register (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs, RBE), administered by the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) under the consolidated Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies; CSSF Regulation No 12-02 of 14 December 2012 and CSSF Circular 20/744 on AML/CFT; Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, as amended (Articles 122-1 et seq. on SARL formation); FIU (Cellule de Renseignement Financier) guidance.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney (procuration) granted to the Luxembourg notary for SARL incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of residence of the shareholder or manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Apostille Convention member state) or Consular Legalization (non-member state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passport and proof of residential address of each UBO, manager, and SPAC sponsor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national authorities of the country of origin (passport office, municipal registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, with certified French, German, or English translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank certificate of deposit of initial share capital (attestation de blocage de fonds) issued by the Luxembourg credit institution holding the SPAC trust/escrow account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg credit institution or EEA-based credit institution opening the account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille required where issued directly by a Luxembourg/EEA credit institution to the notary; Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization required for a confirming bank outside the EEA

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good conduct (casier judiciaire) or police clearance for each proposed manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Criminal records office or judicial authority of the manager's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, with certified translation into French

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate shareholder documentation: certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, current board resolution, and beneficial ownership chart
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry and registered office of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, with certified translation into French

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all UBOs, managers, and SPAC sponsors against: (i) EU consolidated financial sanctions lists (Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014 and related regulations); (ii) UN Security Council consolidated lists; (iii) OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions schedules, mandatory for USD wire rails; (iv) national freezing orders issued by the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance; (v) PEP databases covering foreign and domestic Luxembourg PEPs, family members, and close associates under the extended EU AMLD5 definition, including senior officials of international organisations; (vi) adverse media and negative news checks; enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth, and source-of-funds documentation required for SPAC founder and sponsor contributions; ongoing transaction monitoring must comply with CSSF Regulation No 12-02 and CSSF Circular 20/744.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) online platform, including the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS): www.lbr.lu; pre-incorporation name check and reservation module applicable under the consolidated Law of 19 December 2002.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be written in Latin script; French and German are the official legislative languages, with French as the standard RCS registry language; non-Latin-script names require a certified transliteration into Latin script integrated into the notarial deed; the name must be truthful and non-misleading; the SARL corporate name must include the words 'société à responsabilité limitée' or the abbreviation 'S.à r.l.' / 'SARL'.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Banque (requires prior Ministry of Finance authorisation as a credit institution)
Insurance / Assurance / Assurances (requires prior Commissariat aux Assurances (CAA) authorisation)
Luxembourg / État / National (implies state connection; requires ministerial consent or is prohibited as misleading)
Fiduciaire / Trust / Gestion de Fortune (regulated activity markers; requires prior Ministry of Finance or CSSF approval)
Bourse / Stock Exchange / Regulated Market (requires prior CSSF authorisation for regulated market activity)
Fonds d'investissement / OPC / SIF / RAIF (requires CSSF financial-sector licence or notification)
SPAC acceptable only when it does not suggest an exchange listing, a government sponsor, or a regulated fund product
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the RCS communicates the refusal grounds to the notary or applicant; a revised or new name application opens a new 30-day reservation window; the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Ministry of Justice (directions of the registre) within one month of notification, and a further judicial appeal lies to the Tribunal d'arrondissement (chambre commerciale) of Luxembourg City within one month; parallel use of the refused name is prohibited pending appeal; practical advice: retest the rejected name against RCS, trademark, and CSSF/FIU sensitive-token filters before resubmission.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A mail-forwarding letterbox address alone is not permitted; Luxembourg law (Law of 10 August 1915, Article 122-1) requires a genuine registered office and effective establishment in Luxembourg; a virtual office is permissible only as a supplementary domiciliation service where the provider maintains a permanent physical office in Luxembourg, staffed business hours, meeting facilities, and acceptance of service of process; for this SPAC vehicle, full commercial substance must be verifiable on site, including local management presence, accounting records and minute books kept in Luxembourg, and compliance files accessible to the RCS, FIU, and tax authorities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: approximately 60% annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection for a SPAC (ISIC 6499) using trust/escrow financial rails; inspection risk is driven by the FIU (Cellule de Renseignement Financier), CSSF, and the Administration des contributions directes, and is materially above the standard SARL benchmark due to the blank-check acquisition nature of the vehicle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and notarisation of the SARL articles of association (statuts) before a Luxembourg notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff regulation; approximate flat fee for a standard SARL deed (market range EUR 500-750)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Luxembourg corporate law firm pre-incorporation advisory: SPAC structuring, UBO mapping, and AML/CFT instruction file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of partner and associate hourly rates (EUR 250-500/hour); scope covers KYC, drafts, and notary coordination

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS registration and inscription fee payable via the Luxembourg Business Registers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative tariff under the Law of 19 December 2002 and LBR fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation deed and statutory notices in RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Justice - RESA editorial department (Mémorial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory publication tariff for electronic official journal entries

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French (or German/English) translation and processing of apostilled corporate and KYC documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translation office and origin-country apostille authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate based on certified word/page count plus official apostille application fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank onboarding, AML/KYC processing, and issuance of certificate of blocked initial capital (attestation de blocage de fonds)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (SPAC trust/escrow account bank)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank tariff schedule for corporate account KYC and fund deposit confirmation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register (RBE) initial beneficial ownership declaration filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative tariff of the Law of 13 January 2019; nominal declaration processing and certified excerpt issuance fee (market practice EUR 0-40)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and domiciliation service, first year, with inspection support for a SPAC vehicle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered office provider / corporate services company (PSF)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for SPAC-compliant physical office, mail handling, board room access, and regulatory inspection support (EUR 200-350/month)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as consolidated, particularly Articles 182-1 to 182-90 governing the Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Trade and Companies Register and annual accounts; Law of 13 January 2019 on the Register of Beneficial Owners; Law of 12 November 2004 on anti-money laundering, as amended.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) through the MyGuichet.lu electronic portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Authentic incorporation deed executed by a Luxembourg notary, containing the Articles of Association (Acte de Société / Statuts), filed electronically with the RCS and published in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum issued and fully subscribed capital is EUR 12,000 (Article 182-1). At incorporation each share must be paid up to at least 25% of its nominal value; the statutory capital clearance is evidenced by a certificate ('attestation de capital') issued by a Luxembourg credit institution. For SPAC structures, the offer proceeds are separately segregated under a blocked/escrow trust account with a regulated depositary bank, pursuant to the listing prospectus approved by the CSSF.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the capital of the company is subscribed and paid up to at least 25% of nominal value pursuant to Article 182-1 of the Law of 10 August 1915, as evidenced by the bank certificate. RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be established at [address, Luxembourg City, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg]. RESOLVED, that [name] is appointed as gérant of the company for an unlimited term, solely authorized to bind the company towards the RCS, tax authorities, banks, and the CSSF. RESOLVED, that the gérant shall open the operational bank account and the SPAC escrow/trust account, sign the depositary and trust agreements, and complete the incorporation, registration, RESA publication, and beneficial-owner filings. All prior acts related to incorporation are hereby ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Notarized Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary bound by the Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg and the Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the notary to draft the incorporation deed specifying subscribers, share classes, nominal values, and the appointment of the gérant. The bank capital certificate confirming at least 25% paid-up capital must be delivered before signing. The notary authenticates the instrument and, under the electronic filing procedure, submits the deed and supporting exhibits to the RCS on the same day as execution.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of association
Bank capital certificate evidencing paid-up portion (attestation de capital)
Passport or national ID copies of all individual shareholders and gérant
Certified extract from the RCS for any corporate shareholder, including organizational documents
Signed consent of the landlord for the registered office, including the notarized co-ownership approval if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the bank queries the capital certificate or signatory capacity, a supplementary bank confirmation or a corrective statement is obtained; if a defect in capacity is identified, the notary may either postpone execution or proceed with a post-formation rectification deed, with the RCS registration timeline suspended only for the curing period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) via MyGuichet.lu.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File through the LBR the notarized eCopy of the authentic deed, specimen signatures of each gérant, and the accompanying exhibits. The official registration fee is paid by direct debit or card. Upon validation, the RCS issues the registration number and the certified extract; the company acquires legal personality on this date.
required_dossiers: Notarized electronic copy of the incorporation deed
Specimen signature of each gérant
Pro forma share register listing subscribers and paid-up amounts
Statement confirming the registered office in Luxembourg
Notarial certificate confirming observance of the Law of 10 August 1915
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query for missing exhibits or language formalities, the notary refiles the corrected package on the same business day; unsigned translations may be cured by submission of a certified French or German version within 5 business days, after which the registration proceeds with retroactive effect to the deed date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Legal Information Service of the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice operating the RESA.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The RCS automatically transmits the registration extract and the consolidated articles of association to RESA after registration. The advisor verifies the published notice for accuracy of the corporate name, registered office, capital, share premium, and identity of the gérant.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract (transmitted directly by the RCS to RESA)
Verified consolidated copy of the articles of association for publication proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RESA publication contains inaccurate particulars, a correcting amendment deed is registered with the RCS and republished; the correction procedure is completed within 3 business days of the rectification filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Beneficial Owner Declaration with the RBE Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) acting as the Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of incorporation, file the beneficial ownership declaration through the LBR online portal, identifying each natural person directly or indirectly holding more than 25% of shares or voting rights, or, if none, the senior managing officials. Payment of the applicable state fee is made online.
required_dossiers: RBE declaration form completed online
Chain-of-title ownership chart with exact participation percentages
Statement of voting rights and fiduciary arrangements
Declaration of senior managing officials where no natural-person beneficial owner exists
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the database rejects the economic-rights percentages, the filer submits a corrected declaration with an explanatory note; a rejected declaration may be re-filed without penalty if cured within 5 business days, otherwise the LBR may impose an administrative fine, which is contestable before the administrative courts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Business Establishment Permit (Autorisation d'Établissement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of the Economy, Direction de la Propriété Intellectuelle et du Développement des Entreprises, via the MyGuichet.lu permitting platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Where the SPAC maintains a physical head office with personnel in Luxembourg, submit the establishment authorization request confirming the SARL corporate form, the honorability and professional competence of the gérant, and the absence of conflict with regulated financial sector activities; the permit is issued prior to commencement of operational employment.
required_dossiers: Extract from the RCS and notarized articles
Certificates of honorability and criminal records for each manager
Capital attestation or audited bank statement
Employment contract or occupational scheme for the registered office if staff are engaged
Depositary bank mandate or SPAC trust agreement where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: An adverse decision by the Ministry of the Economy may be appealed to the Minister within 40 days of notification; missing declarations may be completed via the single point of contact at the maison de l'entreprise before the appeal deadline without suspension of the application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, and Anti-Money Laundering Registration; SPAC Listing Safeguards
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'Enregistrement, des Domaines et de la TVA; Administration des Contributions Directes; Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF); Luxembourg Stock Exchange (LuxSE).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the SARL for corporate income tax, municipal business tax, and VAT; complete the anti-money laundering file under the Law of 12 November 2004, including the AML compliance manual and client identification protocol. For a listed SPAC, obtain CSSF prospectus approval, execute the escrow/trust agreement with the depositary bank, and coordinate LuxSE admission procedures.
required_dossiers: RCS extract showing registration date and capital
Bank account and escrow account mandate details
AML compliance manual, beneficial owner information, and risk assessment
CSSF filings for the SPAC listing prospectus and depositary bank agreement
VAT registration form (Formulaire 16) and tax registration questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEDT or ACD issues a query on the tax registration, the taxpayer responds in writing with the corrected information within 15 days; procedural objections before the tax administration suspend any penalty. CSSF comments on the prospectus are addressed by the issuer's legal advisor and refiled; refiling does not restart the statutory review period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy, Direction de l'Industrie; for regulated financial and SPAC listing activity, the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) acting as the industrial financial regulator.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'Établissement (business establishment permit) for the registered office; where listed, combined with the CSSF-approved prospectus and the LuxSE listing admission, and, if the vehicle performs professional depositary or trust services, a Professional of the Financial Sector (PSF) license under the Law of 5 April 1993 on the financial sector, as amended.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Environmental Protection Agency of Luxembourg), Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (category registration only): the SPAC is a non-industrial, blank-check holding vehicle without classified polluting installations (installations classées) under the Law of 15 December 2021 concerning the classification of establishments; no full EIA report is required for office-based administrative premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or industrial effluent is produced; rainwater-connection and domestic sewer discharges must comply with the municipal wastewater agreements. Office-source VOC emissions must remain below the Solvent Emissions Directive 1999/13/EC threshold as transposed; waste handling must conform to Grand-Ducal Regulation of 5 August 2005 and the national waste management hierarchy, with all office waste routed to authorized collectors only.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Corps Grand-Ducal d'Incendie et de Secours (CGDIS) confirming adequate alarms, extinguishers, and evacuation routes; structural load inspection and workplace clearance carried out by the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) covering electrical safety, floor-load capacity, and first-aid provisions. The registered office may not be occupied until the ITM visual clearance and the fire brigade certification are filed, and must remain compliant with the Law of 17 December 2021 on occupational safety at work.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct taxes (corporate income tax, municipal business tax, net wealth tax); Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT and registration duties; official portals: MyGuichet.lu and Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) for RCS registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Incorporation is effected by notarial deed filed with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS); the RCS number and the national identification number (matricule) serve as the master corporate IDs for all tax filings. For VAT, the company files Form 3409 with the AEDT to obtain a VAT identification number (format LU + 8 digits); non-EU-established foreign suppliers with Luxembourg taxable transactions must register through a Luxembourg VAT representative. The ACD assigns the direct-tax reference automatically upon first corporate income tax return filing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A Societe a Responsabilite Limitee (SARL) is a Luxembourg tax-resident company with unlimited tax liability on worldwide income and no pass-through eligibility. It is subject to corporate income tax (national rate 17% plus 7% solidarity surcharge and municipal business tax, combined effective rate of approximately 24.94% in Luxembourg City), net wealth tax (0.5% on net assets exceeding EUR 500,000) and registration duties. The participation exemption (Article 166 LIR) applies to qualifying shareholdings. No special SPAC tax regime exists; a SPAC SARL is taxed as an ordinary company, while issuance of shares and escrow/trust functions are VAT-exempt financial transactions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No Check-the-Box elections. Luxembourg elections: (i) fiscal unity (integration fiscale) under Article 164bis LIR for groups holding at least 95% of the subsidiary, filed with the ACD (subject to ongoing tax reform); (ii) VAT grouping (assujetti unique) for Luxembourg-established persons closely bound by financial, economic and organisational links; (iii) application of the IP box 80% exemption on qualifying IP income (Article 50bis LIR), supported by nexus documentation; (iv) ATAD 2 hybrid-mismatch filing and symmetrical-characterisation documentation for hybrid instruments and hybrid entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA - Taxe sur la valeur ajoutee) under the Loi du 12 fevrier 1979 relative a la taxe sur la valeur ajoutee, transposing EU Directive 2006/112/EC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 0 for non-established foreign suppliers: any taxable supply in Luxembourg triggers VAT registration. Established Luxembourg small enterprises may claim the Article 57 exemption for annual taxable turnover not exceeding EUR 35,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No general B2B real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping or digital stamping regime as of 2024. Since 1 January 2022, invoices issued to the Luxembourg State administration are mandatorily transmitted through the PEPPOL network (Grand-Ducal Regulation of 14 December 2020). VAT returns are filed electronically via the AEDT e-filing portal; customs declarations are filed through the PLDA customs platform. EU-wide ViDA digital reporting and e-invoicing will apply once transposed, with expected application from 2030.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Supplies of goods dispatched or transported by the supplier or on its behalf to destinations outside the EU qualify for 0% VAT under Article 40 of the Luxembourg VAT Law, provided the supplier obtains proof of export (customs export declaration and transport evidence) within 90 days of supply. Transport and ancillary services connected to the exported goods are likewise zero-rated under Article 146(1)(c) of Directive 2006/112/EC. B2B services supplied to customers established outside the EU fall outside Luxembourg VAT scope under the place-of-supply rule in Article 44 of Directive 2006/112/EC, which is economically equivalent to zero-rating. For a SPAC SARL, issuance of shares and escrow, custody and trust-management services are VAT-exempt financial transactions under Article 135 of Directive 2006/112/EC (no input VAT recovery) and remain outside the scope where supplied to non-EU counterparties. The burden of proof rests on the taxable person: the exporter must substantiate physical export, the non-EU establishment of the recipient and the direct link between the service and the export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document - SAD) electronically submitted and discharged via PLDA, including the EU exit confirmation
Bill of Lading / CMR consignment note / Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of the goods from the EU to the non-EU destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank SWIFT MT103 or bank statement) evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list
Transport contract, freight and cargo insurance certificate
Evidence of the non-EU establishment of the customer (foreign VAT ID or commercial register extract)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT may claw back export zero-rating and recharacterize the supply as domestic taxable if proof of export is missing, assessing 17% VAT, denying input VAT deduction and recovering refunds with late-payment interest at 0.6% per month. The reassessment period is 5 years, extended to 10 years in cases of fraud or absence of returns. Administrative fines and criminal sanctions (including fines up to double the tax evaded and imprisonment) may be imposed on the company, its directors or, for non-EU suppliers, the Luxembourg VAT representative, who is jointly and severally liable. Although Luxembourg law does not impose a statutory FX-repatriation deadline, proceeds retained outside Luxembourg beyond the 180-day benchmark without adequate justification attract transfer-pricing scrutiny and possible income recharacterization.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) — Central Bank of Luxembourg, operating under the European System of Central Banks (ESCB), in regulatory coordination with the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) for credit institutions, payment institutions, and e-money institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg is a euro-area Member State; the euro is fully convertible on both current and capital account by virtue of the free movement of capital enshrined in Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU). No exchange control approval, licence, or administrative authorization is required for inbound equity injections, SPAC IPO proceeds, PIPE investments, profit distributions, or outbound acquisition consideration. The only practical restrictions arise from EU/UN sanctions regimes, the EU Anti-Money Laundering Directive (FATF-aligned), and CSSF AML/CFT obligations. Distributions (dividends or redemption proceeds) from the Luxembourg SARL remain subject to the annual statutory audit, the net-assets balance-sheet test under the Luxembourg law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies (as amended), and the applicable withholding tax framework; none of these create FX convertibility or capital repatriation hurdles beyond standard corporate law formality.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable — Luxembourg imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline. As a euro-area jurisdiction, the BCL does not operate a surrender or allocation regime for trade receipts. The only related compliance duty is statistical reporting: resident non-financial corporations must report direct investment positions and cross-border payments to the BCL for euro-area balance-of-payments (BoP) statistics purposes, with periodic filing thresholds; failure to file carries administrative fines but does not constrain the free disposition of FX proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and segregated Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account and segregated Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE / Spuerkeess)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and custody/cash clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for statutory escrow functions, Medium for ancillary operational expense accounts. E-money institutions (EMIs) authorised under PSD2 — including licensed EU fintechs such as Revolut, Wise, or Qonto — may lawfully provide payment accounts, FX conversion, and mass-payment rails, but they cannot provide fiduciary trust, interest-bearing segregated capital escrow, or securities-custody services required for SPAC proceeds. Luxembourg SPAC practice and the CSSF's interpretation of the banking monopoly require the offering proceeds to be held by a credit institution (authorised under Part I of the Luxembourg law of 5 April 1993 on the financial sector) or by a regulated escrow agent. Offshore, non-EU digital EMIs without an EU passport are effectively unusable for any corporate account in Luxembourg and present a settlement and nexus risk; a foreign fintech can only be used for low-value pre-IPO operating disbursements, never as the principal liquidity rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is the default for SPAC-class vehicles rated Medium_Risk_Enhanced by the CSSF AML/CFT framework. Under the Luxembourg Act of 12 November 2004 (as amended) and CSSF Regulation 12-02, identification of UBOs and directors may be performed remotely only where face-to-face contact is unavailable, using a qualified electronic signature (eIDAS), a CSSF-accepted video-identification solution, or identification by a trusted notary/public officer; however, the major domestic and systemically important banks (BGL BNP Paribas, BIL, BCEE) almost uniformly require at the account-opening meeting the physical presence of at least one director or a duly authorised signatory holding a notarised power of attorney, the certified articles of association, the RBE extract, and the signed board resolution approving the account mandate and the escrow agreement. Remote opening is feasible only where the client maintains an existing Prime-banking relationship, in which case the bank may accept a video interview with eIDAS-qualified signatures and apostilled corporate documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Blank-check/SPAC structure flagged under structured-transaction monitoring: large public-offering proceeds credited to a newly formed shell with no operating business and no trading history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CSSF-approved IPO prospectus; underwriter placement and underwriting agreement; stock-exchange admission notice (Euronext Growth or regulated market); escrow agreement with the independent trustee; statutory auditor's report on proceeds receipt; bank-to-bank reference letters; full audit trail of the offering trust account statements and the allocation of proceeds; board resolution authorising the account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex UBO chain with sponsor entities, PIPE investors, and non-EU (US/Cayman/Singapore) shareholders creating opacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) filing and official extract; annotated corporate ownership chart showing ultimate natural persons; certified constitutional documents; notarised share transfer deeds and share registry; FATCA/CRS self-certifications (Form W-8BEN-E, CRS entity self-certificate); sworn source-of-wealth statements from sponsor principals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity cross-border outbound wires to US/NAFTA target companies and non-EU settlement banks denominated in USD, triggering correspondent-bank demurrage suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed business-combination agreement (SPAC merger/bypass agreement); independent fairness opinion and valuation report; supporting target-company audited financials; purpose-code mappings to the Luxembourg BoP statistics (e.g., code 522 for corporate acquisitions); board meeting minutes approving every transfer; the sanctioned disclosure statement filed with the market regulator; evidence of beneficial ownership of the target to exclude third-party money laundering.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or senior-banking scrutiny of high-net-worth sponsor managers and early institutional investors; political-exposure flags or adverse-media hits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated sanctions and PEP screening report from a recognised screening provider (e.g., Dow Jones, LexisNexis, World-Check); negative-news due-diligence report; detailed source-of-wealth and source-of-funds report for each sponsor and investor; certified ID documents and tax-residency certificates; sworn statements of criminal-record clearance in their jurisdiction of residence; CSSF-compliant risk-rating file and enhanced-due-diligence questionnaire.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For SPAC IPO proceeds: the public offering trust account (typically at a New York clearing bank or a US custodian) is released via Fedwire to the Luxembourg SARL's operational account at a Luxembourg credit institution, delivered as SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 COV for the interbank leg) with the European BoP purpose code 'SC' (capital participation / equity securities), referencing the CSSF-approved prospectus and the escrow agreement in field 70. For PIPE placements and sponsor equity injections: standard MT103 credit transfers from the investor's bank with purpose code 'SD' or 'SC', the relevant economic classification, and the share-purchase agreement as reference. The receiving Luxembourg bank verifies the remitter's identity against the UBO list, matches fields 50 and 70 to the board-approved capital schedule, and for amounts above the CSSF threshold completes the BCL statistical reporting and the enhanced due-diligence file before crediting; all flows must be economically coherent with the disclosed SPAC offering memorandum.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Business-combination consideration is settled via SWIFT MT103 (individual customer wires) or MT202 COV (bank-to-bank cover) over TARGET2 for EUR leg and over the USD correspondent banking network (Fedwire/CHIPS) for USD; where the target acquisition is structured as a share or asset purchase with deferred payment, payment is routed against delivery of transfer documents under a funded escrow instruction. For working-capital and trade-related disbursements, the SPAC vehicle may draw on a commercial letter of credit (documentary LC subject to ICC UCP600) negotiated by the target; the settling bank debits the Luxembourg operational account or the escrow sub-account after presentment of compliant documents. Invested escrow proceeds are also returned via MT103 to redeeming shareholders with the code 'P01' (pension/redemption — distributions), alongside the statutory notice and market-disclosure filings; all outbound wires are automatically matched to the approved board minutes and the escrow release condition certificate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD FX forwards (plain vanilla deliverable forwards), with tenors matched to expected acquisition-consideration and redemption-exposure dates
FX options on EUR/USD (call or put structures), with option-premium funding from the operational cash balance
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD CCS) for long-dated matching of USD-denominated target debt or deferred-purchase obligations
FX swaps (swap of principal and interest) for short-term liquidity management between the EUR operational account and USD escrow reinvestment positions

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) strictly limited to settlement currencies not freely convertible (e.g., exotic emerging-market currencies of certain targets), where a deliverable forward is legally or practically unavailable

Permitted only with the two-way dealing counterparties of the Tier-1 Luxembourg bank or its parent group; prohibited: speculative options without an underlying exposure, leveraged derivatives, and any instrument causing the SPAC to deviate from its disclosed investment policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (balance sheet, P&L, annexes) in eCDF format, together with the statutory auditor’s report where audit is mandatory and the director’s management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCSL) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the balance-sheet date / financial year-end; the filing must take place after approval by the shareholders’ meeting held within 6 months of year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal reminder by RCSL; judicial astreinte (potential daily fine) plus late-filing penalties; persistent non-filing for two consecutive financial years exposes the SARL to court-ordered administrative strike-off (radiation) and dissolution. Directors may be jointly and severally liable for resulting damages.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation/update (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) and corrective declaration upon any share transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE), operated by the Luxembourg Business Registers / RCSL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year, aligned with the annual accounts approval; any change in beneficial ownership must be declared within one month of the transfer or amendment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fines up to EUR 1,250,000 for legal persons, EUR 250,000 for natural persons, and imprisonment for knowingly false declarations; repeat non-delivery can be included in RCSL strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual direct-tax returns: corporate income tax return, municipal business tax return, and net wealth tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) - Luxembourg direct-tax administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The Luxembourg corporate tax-year return is due by 31 May of the following year; an approved certified accountant may extend the effective filing deadline to 31 December of that year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default tax assessment, late-payment interest at 0.6% per month, and penalties of up to 10% of the tax due for non-filing or inaccurate filing; directors may be subject to personal liability for tax debts in cases of fraud or prolonged default.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit by a Luxembourg réviseur d’entreprises is required if the SARL exceeds any two of the following three thresholds at the balance-sheet date for two consecutive financial years: total balance-sheet EUR 4,400,000; net turnover EUR 8,800,000; average annual workforce of 50 employees. A SPAC that is listed, carries on financial-sector regulated activity, or is treated as a public-interest entity must appoint an independent auditor irrespective of the thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Luxembourg law of 19 December 2020 on the register of commerce and companies and on annual accounts; accounts must be presented in euros; IFRS is permitted for consolidated accounts and, in limited cases, for voluntary standalone statutory accounts, subject to the Auditor’s formal adoption (non-mandatory).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At least once per calendar year, the SARL managing director must verify that the RBE statement remains accurate and file an annual confirmation or an updated declaration. Any share transfer, change in voting control, or change in the chain of ownership giving rise to a new beneficial owner must be declared to the RBE and the RCSL within one month; the company must map all direct and indirect shareholders and document the SPAC founders, sponsors, and placing/PIPE investors in the internal UBO register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (register of actions/shares), including share classes, transfer history, encumbrances and trust claims
Register of Directors/Managers (register of managers and their appointments, resignations and powers), maintained at the registered office
Minute Book (LV minutes of shareholder resolutions, manager resolutions, AGM minutes, and written decisions)
Annual-accounts dossier, UBO register and audit reports retained for the statutory limitation period

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% national corporate income tax (impôt sur le revenu des collectivités) since 1 January 2023; aggregate rate in Luxembourg City = 22.80% (15% IRC + 1.05% solidarity surcharge + 6.75% communal business tax)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Participation exemption: 100% exemption on qualifying dividends and capital gains (≥10% holding or ≥EUR 6,000,000 acquisition cost, 12-month holding condition); 80% IP box exemption for qualifying intellectual property income (modified nexus); additional small-company allowance and advance tax ruling stabilization
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited for losses incurred from FY2017 onward; pre-2017 losses expire no later than FY2033 (17-year limit); loss forfeiture upon >50% share transfer coupled with a change of business activity (Art. 114 LIR)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ACD Form 1 — Déclaration pour l'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités (CIT return), filed electronically via MyGuichet (eDesk) / ACD eCDF portal; hard-copy filing only on ACD dispensation
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 31 December of the year following the tax year-end (e.g., FYE 31/12/2024 is due 31/12/2025); ACD may demand filing by an earlier deadline for financial vehicles and may send a formal mise en demeure granting 30-60 days

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section A — Identification / EIN (N° de matricule)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal form (SARL), registered office in Luxembourg, trade register number, and tax identification number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident SPACs with a Luxembourg branch use the branch EIN and list the local PE only

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial profit determined in the statutory accounts before loss offset
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Luxembourg-source income attributable to the PE; apply DTA and Art. 156 LIR territorial rules

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dividends from qualifying participations claimed as 100% exempt
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach shareholding certificates, 12-month undertaking, and proof of subject-to-tax of the distributor

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 140 — Capital gains on qualifying participations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gains from disposal of ≥10% participations (or ≥EUR 6,000,000 cost) exempt under Art. 166bis LIR
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain contemporaneous documentation evidencing 12-month holding and anti-abuse conditions

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Carried-forward losses and ATAD interest-limitation recalculations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify no >50% change-of-ownership forfeiture occurred before offsetting old NOLs

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: €250–€2,500 administrative fine (LGI Art. 173); taxation d'office with a 10% surcharge on the assessed tax (Art. 204 LIR); late payment interest of 0.8% per month; criminal prosecution where intent is proven

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ACD Form 4 — Déclaration pour l'impôt commercial communal (Municipal Business Tax return), e-filed with the CIT package
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same statutory calendar as the CIT return (31 December of the following year); assessment notice splits the tax between the national and communal shares

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit as per CIT return adjusted for non-deductible items and the annual TIEd-for-trade exemption
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents with a Luxembourg PE must file; the ICC base is allocable to the Luxembourg fixed place of business

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of the commune's coefficient (Luxembourg City: 225%, equal to 6.75% effective rate)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the coefficient of the commune where the PE/office is situated

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing attracts the same €250–€2,500 fine, 10% assessment surcharge, and 0.8% monthly late-payment interest; the communal tax claim may be enforced jointly with the CIT claim

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ACD Form 5 — Déclaration de l'impôt sur la fortune (Net Wealth Tax return), e-filed via MyGuichet with the annual corporate package
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due with the corporate income tax return; final assessment is issued after the CIT assessment

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net assets (cash, escrow funds, security deposits, intercompany receivables) minus third-party debts, assessed at 1 January of the tax year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Luxembourg-situs assets of a non-resident are taxable; escrow accounts held with Luxembourg banks are taxable situs assets

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the progressive minimum NWT for financial holding/SPAC-type entities with >90% financial assets: EUR 3,210 / EUR 4,815 / EUR 32,100
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum NWT exemption for non-resident PEs; the minimum is due even in loss-making years

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: €250–€2,500 fine and 0.8% monthly interest; tax evasion by omission exposes directors to criminal prosecution

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% statutory Luxembourg withholding tax on dividends (précompte mobilier); 0% for EU/EEA parent companies satisfying the Parent-Subsidiary Directive (≥10% holding, 12-month holding, no anti-abuse disqualification); treaty rates typically 0-15% depending on the residence and holding structure
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Claim exemption-at-source or refund through ACD Form 271 (advance WHT exemption) or Form 270 (refund claim) submitted to the ACD Regional Tax Office (Bureau d'imposition), attaching: original TRC (certificat de résidence fiscale) covering the dividend payment date, share ownership certificate from the depositary, auditor confirmation of the 12-month holding period, and a declaration of beneficial ownership; claims must generally be filed within five years of the end of the calendar year in which the dividend was paid; treaty benefits are denied if the recipient lacks substance or the transaction is abusive under the principal-purpose test
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 0% on arm's length royalty and interest payments to non-resident companies; Luxembourg does not levy a final withholding tax on standard cross-border interest or royalties; exception: profit-participating loans and silent partnerships are assimilated to equity, so the 15% dividend WHT or a treaty-protected rate applies; payments routed through tax-haven intermediaries may be disallowed and recharacterised as constructive dividends

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Master File and Local File (plus CbC report) apply where the ultimate parent group's consolidated revenue equals or exceeds EUR 750,000,000 (EU Directive 2016/881, Luxembourg law of 30 July 2021); below the threshold no automatic filing is prescribed, but the taxpayer must produce a contemporaneous TP file within 30 days of an ACD request and bear the burden of proving arm's length pricing (Art. 56 LIR)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg applies an OECD-aligned substance-over-form doctrine via the fraus legis jurisprudence, the statutory GAAR (Art. 6 LIR transposing ATAD), and the anti-abuse clauses of the participation exemption; a SPAC that behaves as a passive shell — no office, no employees, no local decision-making, no substance commensurate with its activity — risks denial of treaty benefits, recharacterisation of its income, and treatment as an abusive conduit under EU law

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion — deliberately false or incomplete tax filing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly omitting Luxembourg-source income, fabricating expenses, inflating loss carry-forwards, or failing to disclose beneficial owners of the escrow/SPAC vehicle
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax fraud: imprisonment of up to 5 years, fine of up to EUR 50,000, mandatory publication of the judgment, and reassessment of all evaded taxes plus 0.8% monthly late interest and a 10% assessment surcharge
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns may be held jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt in case of gross negligence or deliberate fraud; travel bans and surrender of passports may be ordered; imprisonment is possible for the directing mind

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Conduit — economic substance failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SPAC operated as a letter-box entity: no employees, no Luxembourg office, all management and decision-making outside Luxembourg, escrow funds merely passed through to a foreign sponsor
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation of the entity as fiscally transparent or as an abusive conduit; denial of the participation exemption and treaty withholding relief; retroactive taxation of the full capital gain at 22.80%–24.94%; interest and penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Luxembourg courts may pierce the corporate veil (Art. 585-7 law of 10 August 1915) where the entity is fictitious or assets are confused; directors may be ordered to personally restore the company's assets and may be barred from managing companies for up to ten years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering — unexplained third-party funds in escrow
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting sponsor or investor funds into the trust escrow without beneficial-owner identification, source-of-funds verification, or suspicious-transaction reporting to the FIU (CRF)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to EUR 2,500,000 or 10% of annual turnover under the Law of 10 August 2018 on AML/CFT; freezing of the escrow account; criminal fines and up to 5 years imprisonment for laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The 'director and compliance officer' is personally liable for AML failures; Luxembourg courts may issue travel bans, asset freezes, and disqualification orders; civil damages are available to investors and creditors

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing / Loss Trafficking — abusive intragroup arrangements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging inflated management fees to dilute the SPAC's taxable base, transferring legacy losses through a >50% share acquisition followed by a change of business, or pricing the sponsor promissory note off-market
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Art. 56 LIR upward adjustment of income, disallowance of the deductions, 0.8% monthly late interest, 10% assessment surcharge, and criminal fraud penalties where concealment is proven
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable in insolvency proceedings (action en comblement de passif) for reckless management that caused the tax claim; travel bans may be ordered in cases of cross-border concealment
